info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Returns-v4-spec
info.description: The List Retail Orders Returns API provides businesses with the ability to retrieve detailed information on returned orders from the retail sector. This endpoint facilitates the management of returns by allowing users to access a comprehensive list of return transactions, including their status and associated details. Typical consumers include retail managers and customer service representatives who need to analyze return patterns and improve customer satisfaction. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their return processing efficiency and reduce operational costs.

get.summary: Get return details for an order.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the details for a specific return associated with an order. It provides the necessary information regarding the status and processing of the return, allowing users to track and manage their returns effectively.
